description: The CommandResponse class encapsulates a response to a command in the Eclipse Hono client library. It provides methods to create instances from request details or a message, and exposes properties such as reply-to ID, correlation ID, status, and the underlying message.

classes.name: CommandResponse
classes.description: A wrapper around the payload sent by a device in response to a command, providing methods to create and inspect command responses.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates a CommandResponse instance from request parameters including request ID, tenant ID, device ID, payload, content type, and status. Returns null if inputs are invalid.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates a CommandResponse from an AMQP message. Returns null if message is invalid or has invalid status or missing correlation ID.

methods.name: getReplyToId
methods.description: Returns the reply-to ID extracted from the request ID.

methods.name: getCorrelationId
methods.description: Returns the correlation ID extracted from the message.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code indicating the outcome of the command.

methods.name: toMessage
methods.description: Returns the underlying AMQP Message representing this command response.

methods.name: isReplyToLegacyEndpointUsed
methods.description: Indicates if the command was directed to the legacy control endpoint.
